verdict.rationale: Browserbase is a browser automation infrastructure/platform, not itself an AI agent that would consume other MCP servers' tools — evidence shows the reverse (Browserbase exposes its own official MCP server for other agents to plug into, per browserbase-probe-3), which is a different axis than 'plugging MCP servers into this product.' There's no evidence Browserbase itself acts as an MCP client consuming external tool servers.
